race.comment: ROCK IT ROGER (2) is a classy pup building a strong winning record at the journey. Has quickly put himself into the picture to win the last couple of runs. Last start won this track in a handy 25.52 beating Frozen In Time. Winner at his latest appearance in one of the quickest times on the card. Expected to be right there at the finish again. FORGERY (1) was out of placings last time (20.04) at Angle Park in a Grade 5, finishing fifth and beaten 10 lengths. Has already won four times from this draw. Looks one of the chances. CANYA NAMELESS (8) goes very well at this course having never missed the frame including three wins and five placings. Recorded a 5 length win (22.70) in a Grade 2/3/4 last time at Mt Gambier. Looks one of the chances. VICTA SPENCER (7) warrants respect with the drop in journey.
